title: 部分装备详解第六十五章 力大砖飞超模标杆
content_zh:
黑暗杀戮·魂10
产地:轮回乐园·里德锻造铺
类型:灵魂套装护臂
装备需求:需额外占据三处装备位，灵魂强度275点，真实体力190点，真实智力185点。
不朽级：1300点（提升157）
防御力:240点（仅针对护臂，装甲级防御。）
耐久:325325（提升30点）
套装效果1，杀魂?被动:所有灵魂系技能造成的伤害15%，并将转化为针对灵魂的攻击。
套装效果2，戮魂?被动:对任意目标造成灵魂伤害，若超过目标生命上限20%时，灵魂系判定阶位1，持续15分钟（提升5分钟），此效果不可叠加。
套装效果3，魂傀（主动）:激活后，可消耗自身50%（降低40%）的魂能，生成具具有独立意识的灵魂分身，最多可同时生成两具（新增），无持续时间，冷却4（降低3）个自然日。
提示:灵魂分身在『黑暗环境』下，将同步具有『杀魂』和『戮魂』的效果。
二次熔铸·烬魂（被动）:当灵魂分身存在时，猎杀者受到的所有伤害，都将随之转嫁。
提示：若灵魂分身死亡，将对击杀者造成，自身灵魂强度*10的魂震荡伤害
提示:若灵魂分身击杀了任意目标，将立即凝聚新的灵魂分身，最大可同时存在33灵魂分身。
提示:在灵魂分身死亡后，猎杀者将不会再降低灵魂强度。
提示:灵魂分身的灵魂强度和灵魂阶位，将等同于猎杀者
生肖符咒·羊（强化5，不朽级）:猎杀者遭受灵魂攻击时，灵魂强度将临时提升25点，若存在灵魂分身，将额外临时提升15点。
强化8：魂能消耗降低30%，『魂傀』冷却缩减降低3个自然日。
强化10：魂能消耗降低10%，『魂傀』一次性最大可以生成两具灵魂傀儡。
简介:烬火焚魂，黑枫葬灵，以寂灭禁锢众生魂魄，以魂牵梦绕风云荡。

……
回溯之瞳10
产地:轮回乐园
类型:眼部装备灵魂装备
材质:玉龙之泪，魂源，生命之树树脂……
不朽级：1410点
装备效果1，次元空域（主动）:开启后，每分钟消耗1点神灵之力，可与你视线之内的目标互换位置，且将自动记录5秒前的空间坐标为临时锚点，锚点存续35秒。无冷却时间。
提示：在空间锚点存续期间，可选择激活锚点，看到临时锚点所在的视界。
提示:在猎杀者与目标进行空间传输时，你将进入『虚化』状态，免疫任何形式的物理伤害，此效果无冷却。
提示:在次元空域开启期间，空间『穿梭』速度提升50%（提升20%），空间抗性提升10点。
装备效果2，次元预察（被动）:次元空域持续时间内，若你进入『愤怒』状态，动态视力140%，视力范围提升250%
提示:当遭遇空间封锁时，你可通过‘透支’生命为代价，无视此次封锁效果。透支生命时，将根据‘空间封锁’阶位高低百分比1%~30%（降低50%）扣除最大生命值。（最高可对8阶空间封锁生效）
强化5:动态视力提升10%，视力范围提升5%。
强化8:动态视力提升5%，视力范围提升15%。
强化10：突破空间封锁时，最大生命值扣除上限降低50%，空间穿梭速度提升20%
简介:临时定格刹那的坐标，回放过往寸步行迹，当我的瞳光所及，一切的时序都尽在掌握，虚化之影穿梭于空域裂隙。
……
异次元之靴10
content_en:
Dark Kill·Soul 10
Place of Origin: Reincarnation Paradise·Reed’s Forge Shop
Type: Soul Suit Armguards
Equipment requirements: need to occupy three additional equipment slots, soul strength 275 points, real physical strength 190 points, and real intelligence 185 points.
Immortal level: 1300 points (increased by 157)
Defense: 240 points (only for arm guards, armor-level defense.)
Durability: 325325 (increased by 30 points)
Set effect 1, Soul Killing? Passive: All soul-based skills cause 15% damage and will be converted into attacks against the soul.
Set effect 2, Soul Killing? Passive: Causes soul damage to any target. If it exceeds 20% of the target's upper limit of life, the soul system judgment level is 1, which lasts for 15 minutes (increased by 5 minutes). This effect cannot be superimposed.
Set Effect 3, Soul Puppet (Active): After activation, it can consume 50% of one's own soul energy (reduced by 40%) to generate soul clones with independent consciousness. Up to two soul clones can be generated at the same time (newly added). There is no duration and the cooldown is 4 (reduced by 3) natural days.
Tip: The soul clone will have the effects of "Soul Killing" and "Soul Killing" simultaneously in the "dark environment".
Second Forging·Ember Soul (Passive): When the soul clone exists, all damage suffered by the hunter will be passed on.
Tip: If the soul clone dies, it will cause soul shock damage equal to own soul strength*10 to the killer.
Tip: If the soul clone kills any target, a new soul clone will be formed immediately. A maximum of 33 soul clones can exist at the same time.
Tip: After the death of the soul clone, the hunter will no longer reduce the soul strength.
Tip: The soul strength and soul level of the soul clone will be equal to the hunter
Zodiac Talisman·Sheep (Enhancement 5, Immortal Level): When the hunter is attacked by a soul, the soul strength will be temporarily increased by 25 points. If there is a soul clone, an additional 15 points will be temporarily increased.
Enhancement 8: Soul energy consumption is reduced by 30%, and the cooldown reduction of "Soul Puppet" is reduced by 3 natural days.
Enhancement 10: Soul energy consumption is reduced by 10%. "Soul Puppet" can generate up to two soul puppets at a time.
Introduction: Ember fire burns souls, black maple buries souls, imprisons the souls of all living beings with silence, and haunts the wind and clouds with dreams.
…
Eye of Retrospect 10
Place of Origin: Samsara Paradise
Type: Eye Equipment Soul Equipment
Material: Tears of the Jade Dragon, Soul Source, Tree of Life Resin...
Immortal level: 1410 points
Equipment effect 1, Dimensional airspace (active): After being turned on, it consumes 1 point of divine power every minute, can exchange positions with the target within your sight, and will automatically record the space coordinates 5 seconds ago as a temporary anchor point, which lasts for 35 seconds. No cooldown time.
Tip: During the existence of the spatial anchor point, you can choose to activate the anchor point and see the visual field where the temporary anchor point is located.
Tip: When the hunter and the target are transmitting space, you will enter the "virtual" state and be immune to any form of physical damage. This effect has no cooldown.
Tip: While the dimensional airspace is open, the space "shuttle" speed is increased by 50% (increased by 20%), and the space resistance is increased by 10 points.
Equipment Effect 2, Dimensional Prediction (Passive): During the duration of the dimensional airspace, if you enter the "angry" state, dynamic vision will be 140%, and vision range will be increased by 250%
Tip: When encountering a space blockade, you can ignore the effect of the blockade by 'overdrafting' your life. When the health is overdrawn, the maximum health will be deducted according to the percentage of the 'Space Blockade' level of 1% to 30% (reduced by 50%). (Can take effect on up to 8th level space blockade)
Enhancement 5: Dynamic vision is increased by 10%, and vision range is increased by 5%.
Enhancement 8: Dynamic vision is increased by 5%, and vision range is increased by 15%.
Enhancement 10: When breaking through the space blockade, the maximum HP deduction limit is reduced by 50%, and the space shuttle speed is increased by 20%
Introduction: Temporarily freeze the coordinates of the moment and play back the traces of the past inches. When my pupils reach it, I can control the timing of everything, and the virtual shadow shuttles through the cracks in the air.
…
